description: This file implements the gRPC API for managing cluster members in etcd, including adding, removing, updating, listing, and promoting members.

classes.name: ClusterServer
classes.description: A server managing cluster membership operations via gRPC.

methods.name: MemberAdd
methods.description: Adds a new member to the cluster, optionally as a learner.

methods.name: MemberRemove
methods.description: Removes a member from the cluster by ID.

methods.name: MemberUpdate
methods.description: Updates the peer URLs of a cluster member.

methods.name: MemberList
methods.description: Lists all cluster members, with optional linearizable read.

methods.name: MemberPromote
methods.description: Promotes a member to a voting member.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Constructs a response header with cluster and server info.
